pairs.evidence: crates/store-pg/src/dataset_lineage.rs:262 This context only does exact-predicate CRUD and filtered, sampled selection: rows ordered by RANDOM() or recency for dataset mining, scores by created_at. A query is never matched against a corpus by lexical or semantic relevance to give a consumer a ranked slice, and a grep of crates/store-pg for embedding/cosine/rerank/retriev/tsvector/nearest found 0 hits, so none of the retrieval techniques' preconditions hold.
